# Multitude

> Multitude is a free, open-source Unity editor extension (dual-licensed LGPL-3.0 or AGPL-3.0) that opens
> several prefabs at the same time, each in its own window with an isolated session, a 3D preview and a
> real inspector. It replaces the single prefab stage workflow. Unity 6000.6 (Unity 6.6) or newer, editor
> only, no runtime code. Free and open source. Current version: 0.1.0.

- Repository: https://github.com/gabriel96x1/Multitude
- Landing page (English): https://gabriel96x1.github.io/Multitude/
- Landing page (Spanish): https://gabriel96x1.github.io/Multitude/es/
- Latest release: https://github.com/gabriel96x1/Multitude/releases/latest
- License: LGPL-3.0 or AGPL-3.0, dual licensed — https://github.com/gabriel96x1/Multitude/blob/master/LICENSE
- Author: Gabriel RZ

## Download

- [unitypackage](https://github.com/gabriel96x1/Multitude/releases/download/v0.1.0/Multitude-0.1.0.unitypackage): drag into the Unity Project window, lands in Assets/Multitude/
- [tarball](https://github.com/gabriel96x1/Multitude/releases/download/v0.1.0/com.gabs.multitude-0.1.0.tgz): Package Manager > Add package from tarball
- [git URL](https://github.com/gabriel96x1/Multitude.git): Package Manager > Add package from git URL (pin with #v0.1.0)

## Facts an agent needs

- Unity 6000.6 (Unity 6.6) or newer; developed and tested on 6000.6.2f1.
- Editor only: a single Editor assembly (Multitude.Editor). No runtime assembly, no build impact.
- No render pipeline dependency; tested with URP 17.6.
- Works on ordinary prefabs and prefab variants. Model prefabs and scenes are out of scope.
- Nothing is written to disk until the user presses Apply; if the prefab changed on disk, Apply offers
  Overwrite / Keep editing / Reload from disk.
- Free: no paid tier, no account, no licence server, no Unity subscription required.
- Install ONE route. The .unitypackage (Assets/Multitude) and the package routes (Packages/) compile the
  same types twice if both are installed.
- The .unitypackage excludes Tests/ and Documentation~/ (Unity ignores folders ending in ~).
